description:
Tray companion that shows how much Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and other AI coding agent quota you have left, per account.

Agent Cat is a free Windows tray app for developers who run AI coding agents.
It shows, per account, how much quota is left and when it resets for Claude Code,
Codex, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, GitHub Copilot, Grok, Kimi and more, with a
7-day token chart, a dashboard for usage, limits, history and projects, and an
optional always-on-top strip with rotating per-account quota.
Usage is read locally by an open-source connector; prompts, responses and
source code are never collected.
Turning an agent's Visible switch off now removes it from the popover and overview.
Agents you never used no longer appear; a card needs a live limit, credit, recent usage, or a running process.
The popover asks you to install, update, or repair the connector when needed.
Pins connector 26.40.3.
